description: The ego can be dangerous. Check it before it checks you #egodeath #fyp #lifebydesign #leadershipdevelopment
transcript: One of my most consistent reminders to myself is to check my ego at the door. When I don't check my ego, I put value into things where value should not be held. When I check myself, I lean back into reality and I see me for who I am in reality. Check your ego at the door.
